object: tab:hl MP baseline -- median-unbiased half-lives with the RECURSIVE (i.i.d., homoskedastic) grid-t bootstrap CI. The MP point estimates (alpha_mu_MP, HL_scalar_MP, ...) are the SAME as in hl_results_wild.csv (median-unbiased inversion is bootstrap-scheme-independent); only the CI columns differ by scheme. The printed tab:hl LB CI is the WILD file; this recursive file is the homoskedastic baseline.

production_N.determinism: np.random.seed(RNG_SEED + node) inside the njit kernels; fixed seed + fixed (nsim,B) => bit-reproducible.

re_mint_note: v2.0.1 re-mint. The v2.0.0 golden was minted at a MODEST N (~nsim 1e4), NOT the production nsim=1e6/B=19999. This re-mint is the documented production run. No code or classification change.

what_changed_vs_v2_0_0_golden.flags: UNCHANGED -- collapses (NOK, SEK), JPY collapse=0 / LB_includes_one=1 (the scheme-dependence baseline), all includes_one identical.
what_changed_vs_v2_0_0_golden.points_and_CIs: small N-precision shifts: HL_scalar_LB within ~0.23 yr (CHF 6.85->7.08); a few LB/MP CI edges move by one grid node (CAD LB upper 45.86->68.97, GBP/NZD LB upper down one node). Median LB HL 3.0 unchanged.

role: MP baseline / robustness companion to hl_results_wild.csv. The manuscript's printed tab:hl LB CI and Figure S2 come from the WILD file; this recursive file demonstrates the homoskedastic-vs-wild scheme dependence (esp. JPY: collapse only under wild).
